title: Hand wash only!
text:
Hand wash only!. Amazon website says this food processor is dishwasher safe. The manual that came with the food processor, says this food processor, is NOT dishwasher safe! The blades are sharp, and I don't want to have to hand wash them.

I'm returning this.

Maybe this is the reason Braun, isn't making these any more.
